talk.offline: Not connected to the server (reloads when it connects)
talk.gone.owner: This robot's session ended an hour ago, so its talks are gone
talk.gone.peer: The other session ended an hour ago, so the talk is gone
talk.title: Talk
talk.foot: View only (nothing is sent from the talk)
talk.back.list.aria: Back to the list of talks
talk.peer.unseen: Not visible on this machine (cannot switch)
talk.state.undelivered.why: Did not reach the other side (not on this machine, or the name did not resolve)
talk.merged: (the recipient got two messages as one)
talk.robot.absent: This robot is not on this page now (cannot switch)
talk.list.empty: No talks yet (conversations this robot sent or received with SendMessage show here)
talk.robots.empty: No robot without a talk here now
talk.go.absent: This robot is not on this page now (cannot go to it)
bill.notice: The amounts on the bills are estimates (the official prices × each response's tokens). With a subscription they do not match what is actually billed.
bill.title.unpriced: a model with no price (add one in Settings › Prices)
bill.switch.on: On — each response's estimated amount shows over its robot
pr.none: The price table has not arrived yet.
pr.model.label: Model (as the transcript writes message.model)
pr.hint: USD per million tokens. Copy the values from the official pricing page.

pr.unpriced: Models with no price (no amount shown)
pr.live.only: Can be changed in the live view only
pr.done.reset: {model}: back to default (from the next response)
pr.chip.title: {models} — no amount shown for these. Press to add a price
ds.live.only: Shown in the live view only
ds.col.name: Name
ds.none: No specs found in this room's docs/api or docs/db

ds.skipped.one: {n} file not read (over the size limit)
ds.skipped.other: {n} files not read (over the size limit)

log.demo.source.decision: Agent view → Claude Code (the answer to the PermissionRequest hook)
log.title: Event log
log.note.live: What the server received (long values cut)
log.note.decision: An example of the answer sent back to Claude Code when pressed in the view
log.note.server: An example of an event the view's server makes
log.note.hook: An example of a hook's input (the field names are real; the values are the demo's)
page.title: JsonUI Agent View
page.chip.input.title: Sessions waiting for your reply (press to open that session's talk)
page.chip.denied.title: Actions auto mode stopped (press to see them on the board)
page.chip.askwait.title: While a question waits in viz, the terminal and VS Code do not show it (press to change)
page.scene.aria: A 3D view of a room per project folder, where robots in headbands write specs, implement and test
page.legend.busy: Working — the light is on, the robot moves
page.legend.thinking: Thinking — the light is on, hand on chin
page.legend.waiting: Waiting for permission — a yellow frame, hand raised
page.legend.background: Working in the background — the light stays on, sitting and watching the screen
page.legend.idle: Idle — the light is off, only a shadow
page.empty.title: No Claude Code sessions visible yet
page.empty.server: This server is running (`jui viz status`)
page.empty.hooks: The hooks are installed (`jui viz hooks status`)
page.scene.hint: Drag to rotate / wheel to zoom / press a board or a robot for details
page.wb.title: Spec board
page.tb.title: Task board
page.sr.title: Server room
page.sr.canvas.aria: A 3D view of the infrastructure (drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, right-drag to pan, Option + drag to zoom to an area)
page.sr.boxzoom.title: Draw a box with the next drag and zoom to it (Option + drag draws one too; Esc to cancel)
page.ds.title: Data server
page.pr.title: Price table (bill estimates)
page.weather.hint: Turning it on asks for your location; the server then asks for the weather every 30 minutes at a location rounded to about 1 km. It shows in the whole-building view (7 rooms or more).
page.bill.hint: Amounts are estimates: the official prices × each response's tokens. With a subscription they do not match what is actually billed.
page.dev.title: Machine load and devices
page.notify.title: Notifications, and how long questions wait
page.notify.os.note: Turn on Google Chrome in Mac System Settings → Notifications (while it is off no notification shows, and questions still wait in viz).
page.notify.kinds: What to notify (remembered in this browser)
page.notify.done: Done (the end of the main session's turn)
page.notify.idle: Waiting for input (1 minute after the turn ends, with no reply)
page.notify.chime: Play a sound (a short chime, in the tab that showed the notification)
page.askwait.label: How long a question waits in viz (saved on the server)
page.askwait.note: While it waits, the terminal and VS Code do not show the question. “Answer in the terminal” on the card sends it back at any time. Closing every viz page sends it back in about 12 seconds. While no page is visible, it waits only while question notifications are on and allowed.
page.call.title: Call a robot
page.call.name: Name (required, one line)
page.call.cmd: Command to paste in a terminal
page.call.note: viz does not run this command. Paste it in a terminal and run it yourself. The name and the role are each passed as one argument.
